G-ED.8.read: QA's own diff reproduces render-agent's totals exactly (288,321 px; 2,910 at L* >= 20, 786 of them > 2 levels, all inside the (b) mask). Outside the mask every changed px had L* < 20 (max 16.5), 0 at L* >= 20: the toe only. The toe as it landed is one monotone curve (0 drops), +2.2 at L* 8, +1.2 at 12, +0.6 at 14, 0 from 18; hue within +-2.3 deg (p1-p99), chroma never down. The cushion: 0 px changed in QA's mask (round 5's and the same recipe on fix5), and (b)'s mask stays 2-8 px off its edge (the contact line). The duvet: 0 from (b); the 1,021 toe px in the zone below the contact line are the open book's dark photo and the mug's shadow (y 1019-1085, L* < 16.1, max 7 levels). The ring band of polish (a): 0 overlap, 0 changes.

G-ED.9.read: At 100 % and x4 (also stretched): no step, halo or ghost on (b)'s edge. (b) alone (QA's empirical toe taken off both sides) adds at most 0.41 L* across the mask's edge (p99 0.26) and its own lift is ~0 on the mask's inner 2 px (p99 0.42, max 1.0): it fades out inside the mask. The wedge keeps its shape and the creases inside it (high-pass SD x0.95, correlation 0.994). Contact lines kept: along the cushion's right edge 7.1 against 8.9 in the shadow beside it (fix5: 3.5 against 3.2, no separate line); along the base on the duvet darker than the shadow above in every sampled column. No colour blotch: 0 off-family px (hue outside 20-110 deg with C* >= 3) among the 288,321 changed px; the void under the nightstand reads a smooth warm dark (h 55.4, C* 8.1), no purple or red speck at x4 stretched. The muslin folds open and stay pecan (h 53.2 -> 52.9, C* 22.7 -> 23.6, grain x0.94, corr 0.98); the walnut nightstand keeps its grain (x0.93, corr 0.99).
